name: TOFU
description: TOFU is a benchmark designed to evaluate the efficacy of unlearning methods in large language models by providing synthetic author profiles with question-answer pairs and metrics to assess how well models forget specified data.
reputation: TOFU has become a commonly cited benchmark for evaluating LLM unlearning methods and is frequently used in unlearning papers, though it is still a specialized research benchmark rather than a broad leaderboard staple.
notes: Dataset includes 200 synthetic author profiles each with 20 QA pairs; none of existing unlearning baselines show effective unlearning on this benchmark.
